register_cost.note: declared cost of a defect of each class in the register of these runs, in cost units; five cost units are paid by one unit of released load potential. Declared, not derived.

wave_bands.wiring: symmetric wiring of the federation (three glued ports per carrier)
wave_bands.note: levels of the port operator at zero wave number. On a continuous flow with pulse rate nu a band has rest frequency nu sqrt(level); it shares the cone of the massless band only if its curvature equals that of the massless band. No band is assigned to a particle.

transverse_bands.note: seam and face modes of the symmetric wiring; they have no load component. The plaquette boundary inside a carrier is a declared choice.

flux_gaps.note: Lowest levels of the recharted port operator on the flat federation with one glue port per neighbour, in units of the kernel (relaxation rate times 2M). The level is the flux gap of one carrier and does not depend on the size of the federation. Flat branches do not move. Under the coherent walk a level becomes a frequency; the length scale of this gap is 0.14 mesh edges, a gap at the cutoff. Not assigned to a particle.

gluings.gluing: a shared seam per neighbour, common frame

family_walk.note: A declared extension of the public walk to the federation: the quantum uses the address register of the carrier that holds it. Its phases follow exactly from the bands of the recharted port operator. Rest phases are in radians per walk step, speeds in mesh edges per walk step. A branch with a rest phase and the speed of the massless branch has the form of a mass shell in this clock. The rest phases sit at the cutoff: the Compton lengths are a fraction of one mesh edge. Not assigned to a particle.

coherent_walk.note: Public program of the audit in the theory repository (model/coherent_seam_repair). The removed seam disagreement is kept in a coherent record and the seam address is reflected; the step is unitary and every relaxation factor of the reference rule becomes a frequency, in radians per walk step. One carrier only. A frequency of a finite carrier is not a rest mass.

integer_filling.note: on a whole-number background a raised port and a lowered port are particle and antiparticle of the bare law; each costs one half of the mismatch potential and a pair annihilates with release exactly 1 (measured: 192,528 of 192,528 pairs at level 6).

internal_modes.statement: Five internal levels of a carrier: three vector levels and two spinor levels. A multiplet is an occupation pattern (n3, n2). Its charge 3 n2 - 2 n3 is six times the hypercharge, and the parity of n3 + n2 is the handedness. The charge modulo 6 decides which centre fluxes the pattern sees. The twelve patterns are one generation of the Standard Model and its conjugate. Generations are not separated by the pattern.
internal_modes.origin: The vector triplet is the consensus space of vector agreement on pairs of faces, the spinor doublet that of spinor agreement on faces (repair-law search, 10 November). The public program coherent-seam-repair-v1 carries exactly this five-level factor on its walk and conserves the charge. The port loads compressed to it generate u(1) + su(2) + su(3).
internal_modes.checks: On each of the two handedness classes the four anomaly sums vanish, and the sum of T3 squared over the sum of electric charge squared is 3/8. The sum of the twelve port responses is the charge itself, diag(2,2,2,-3,-3). Which class is called matter is a convention: nothing supplies chirality yet.
internal_modes.higgs: The Higgs is not a pattern. It is the operator that adds or removes one spinor-level quantum, so it links each left-handed pattern to its right-handed partners: (1,1) with (1,2) and (1,0), (3,1) with (3,0) and (3,2). A mass term sits on these links. Of the five such operators exactly one conserves colour and electric charge, the one on the neutral spinor level. So one amplitude gives one common mass to up type, down type, charged lepton and neutrino: separate masses and three generations need structure beyond one occupation algebra. Declared, no value. The gauge fields are the twelve port responses and leave the pattern unchanged.
internal_modes.fluxes: The defects of the big runs are not patterns. A register class k is a flux of the centre of the gauge group: a pattern of charge Q sees it as the phase exp(2 pi i k Q / 6). Class 3 is the central minus one of the weak group, seen by patterns with one spinor level filled; classes 2 and 4 are the centre of the colour group, seen by patterns with one or two vector levels filled; classes 1 and 5 generate.
internal_modes.status: A labelling, revised best guess. No pattern is an identified particle and no mass follows from it.
internal_modes.splits: An earlier version of this page read flux class k as the particle of charge k. That is a duality between fluxes and charges which the construction does not supply; particle names now sit on patterns only.

*: antineutrino, left-handed singlet (conjugate of a right-handed neutrino)

generations.statement: Three generations are not in the five levels. The best candidate so far is the second triplet of the carrier, which the five levels do not use. If it were the generation space, one kind of mass would be diagonal along a port and the other along a cubic frame of the carrier, and the two bases are mismatched by a fixed pattern.
generations.caveats: Squared sines of the lepton mixing angles. The comparison is not blind: the measured values were known when it was made. The third angle is zero in the pattern and is not zero in nature. Three identical levels have equal spectra, so they cannot be three particles of different mass without a breaking that nothing supplies yet. Found by the theory session.

defect_map.status: best guess by structure; not a derivation
defect_map.rule: A register class k of Z6 is the pair (k mod 3, k mod 2): a colour-centre charge and a weak-centre parity. The known multiplets carry exactly these pairs: quark doublets (1 or 2, odd), quark singlets (1 or 2, even), lepton doublets (0, odd), lepton singlets (0, even).
defect_map.constraint: The classes on the twenty faces of a carrier sum to zero. So a colour charge never sits alone on a carrier: only pairs and triples without net charge occur. In nature this is the rule that quarks come in mesons and baryons.

defect_map.balance: Baryon-like and antibaryon-like groups: 86,476 against 86,788 at level 10. Over levels 5 to 10 the two differ by 0.13 ± 0.21 percent. They are made through mirror channels at equal rates and sit at random, without clustering. The run has no excess of matter over antimatter.
defect_map.fusion: All 11.5 million fusions and splits in the stored runs obey addition modulo 6, without one exception, and the tables are the same for a class and its conjugate. Content never moves from one carrier to another.
defect_map.hadron_gas: For orientation: in a hot gas of hadrons at the temperature where quarks bind, protons and neutrons are a few percent of the pions. In the run the baryon-like groups are 1.7 percent of the meson-like groups.

h2.note: Routing of each kind of quantum through a static gas of link flux with the densities of the frozen classes, 96 x 48 x 48 carriers. Mean free path of the ballistic packet, relative to a free quantum.
h2.composite: A point object made of three quark quanta has no colour-centre charge. It reads the links exactly as a lepton doublet does and gets as far. A quark and an antiquark held apart are lost at twice the single rate in this gas, and at 0.6 to 0.8 of it in a gas of long flux lines: the arrangement of the flux matters and is not derived.

mass: The native idle interaction vanishes on the fifteen-state internal module. That alone supplies neither propagating massless particles nor an interacting mass spectrum.
A Higgs-type quantum memory permits invariant Yukawa couplings. This is one declared mass-generating mechanism; its interacting reference and physical parameters require calculation.

The frozen flux of the run is such a state. Read as a background it gives quarks about three times the rest phase of leptons and leaves the right-handed electron at zero. It was set by how the run was prepared: loads seeded from 0 to 5 leave 0.268 pairs per carrier, loads from 0 to 3 leave 0.008, and a start inside the settled band leaves none.

rows.label: Exchange-orientation bit
rows.description: A coherent orientation bit carries two protected charge sectors under the specified ordered-cover repair.
rows.domain: H66 with a coherent orientation bit; complete ordered-cover repair
rows.protected_object: Q=I66 tensor X, two sharp eigenvalue sectors
rows.topology: Z2 character of the ordered exchange cover
rows.result: The coherent ordered-cover bit gives two sharp repair-protected sectors.
rows.first_required: Attach the bit to a spatially accessible source excitation and a specified energy generator.
remaining: Prove that its local creation and transport retain the charge under the complete repair and field process.
Calculate the original joint energy/momentum law and test a particle threshold or branch.
Identify physical exchange, currents, interactions and the mass observable.
rows.shortcut: The exchange-cover character supplies a source label; its conservation does not supply a dispersion relation.

rows.label: Spin-rotation charge
rows.description: A local spin operation creates two opposite conserved internal-charge channels. This charge is not identified with electric charge.
rows.domain: actual eight-site selected spin cube, J=1, B=1/4; inherited two-flavor repair
rows.protected_object: integer U1 spin charge Q; global X parity is exp(i pi Q); local Z creates two sharp Q=+/-1 channels
rows.topology: global internal U1 symmetry, not a winding number or identified electric charge
rows.result: The selected eight-site spin source has local creation, two sharp internal charge sectors, a positive finite energy response and a controlled detector lifetime.
rows.first_required: Resolve the created charge channel in operational momentum on its selected state and clock.
remaining: Separate the moving response from other spin channels and control volume, preparation and cutoff errors.
Prove the physical Lorentz/current dictionary and interaction records.
Extract a rest threshold in that dictionary; its finite selection-energy gap alone is insufficient.
rows.shortcut: Reuse the existing local preparation and lifetime proof; no second proof of a nonzero finite response is needed.

rows.label: One-particle-per-site spin memory
rows.description: Repair preserves the spin information in a fixed-occupation code. Identity repair supplies no winding invariant.
rows.domain: eight-site one-particle-per-site spin code with complete C/E repair
rows.protected_object: full M256 operator algebra under repair alone
rows.topology: no topological label supplied by identity repair
rows.result: Complete repair acts identically on the one-fermion-per-site spin code.
rows.first_required: Choose a physical excitation within the code and bind its Hamiltonian, state and clock, including any leakage under evolution.
remaining: Use the complete same-process record law to control leakage and controller energy.
Calculate a populated moving sector, its physical spin/current attachment and mass definition.
rows.shortcut: An invariant information algebra is not a catalogue of its energy-carrying excitations.

rows.label: Canonical spin fields
rows.description: A specified spin family admits two canonical field pairs with one positive-energy clock. Its physical particle dictionary is unassigned.
rows.domain: protected spin interaction H_B=J sum(S_x.S_y-1/4)-B sum epsilon_x S_x^1; supplied p=n^-2 and B=J n^-5; positive-B ground and retained H_B clock
rows.protected_object: two regular canonical pairs (Q3,P2) and (Q2,P3), with common positive-energy time and full internal U1 on their bounded histories
rows.topology: internal source spin rotation, no spatial winding or identified electromagnetic charge
rows.result: The specified positive-field spin scaling gives two regular canonical pairs on one ground-state family with a positive-energy clock.
rows.first_required: Determine the joint energy/momentum spectral measure and stiffness of these actual canonical fields.
remaining: Control the selected-field scaling and identify whether the response is massless, massive or nonrelativistic.
Prove physical Lorentz transformations and interactions of the populated sectors.
Identify any observable species and its mass without replacing this state or clock.
rows.shortcut: Canonical commutation and positive energy are supplied; a numerical stiffness or relativistic mass shell is not.

rows.label: Shared spin subsystem
rows.description: A qutrit spin factor survives both the stated field dynamics and repair, with 105 multiplicity states.
rows.domain: same six-site Weyl/contact field and complete charged-block repair
rows.protected_object: at N=4, S=1, a qutrit with 105 multiplicity states, total dimension315
rows.topology: internal spin factor, no topological boundary invariant
rows.result: The same chain field and repair preserve a spin factor with H=h tensor I. Complete finite spectra and candidate probes are available in their declared reference.
rows.first_required: Select an operator that changes the energy-carrying multiplicity or number sector, rather than only rotating the protected spin.
remaining: Control energy/work during repair: conservation of the spin factor does not imply conservation of the joined Hamiltonian.
Establish spatial propagation and a controlled higher-dimensional extension, respecting the proved frame-alignment condition.
Identify Lorentz spin and physical currents before extracting a particle mass.
rows.shortcut: Every operator I tensor A on the isolated protected spin factor commutes with H and has only zero ideal energy transfer.

rows.label: Eta-pairing sector
rows.description: A rank-1820 symmetry sector is protected by the specified dynamics and repair. Its label is internal eta symmetry.
rows.domain: original eight-site Weyl/contact field with the stated four-dimer repair
rows.protected_object: rank1820 image of eta+ from N4 to N6; eta>=2 sector
rows.topology: eta symmetry representation, no spatial winding invariant
rows.result: The eta>=2 range is exactly protected; H_6 V=V(H_4+U) and the prepared fixed-number local probe has eight interacting spectral lines.
rows.first_required: Attach the existing local spectroscopy to a moving branch, including complete detector and evolution implementation errors.
remaining: Keep one reference and clock: the eta ladder shifts H energy by U while changing occupation by two.
Control growing-volume dispersion and physical currents/spin, including repair and compensating occupations.
Extract the branch mass; U or U/2 is not thereby an elementary rest mass.
rows.shortcut: Reuse the exact eta intertwiner and local resolvent; the model spectral lines need no guessed particle names.

rows.label: Mobile vacancy with a spin record
rows.description: One missing occupation can be located, while recorded transport carries the remaining spin information.
rows.domain: full two-flavour CAR repair on H_h: one empty site and one fermion at every other site; dimension V 2^(V-1)
rows.protected_object: hole-position projectors and internal spin information carried by the recorded signed transport; conditional block dimension 2^(V-1)
rows.topology: one-unit occupation deficit, without a topological invariant or physical particle assignment

rows.label: Opposite winding cores

remaining: For a massive branch, determine the mass-generating coefficients or order from that declared dynamics and state.
Establish populated interacting spectral branches, physical currents and the fate of mirror modes.
Control refinement and map the resulting thresholds to observed species.
